jobs.title: Business Operations
jobs.description:
ABOUT FACTORY



Our mission is to create a world where software builds and improves itself.

We build the platform for self-improving software development, helping the world's largest enterprise engineering teams turn their organizations into autonomous software factories. Customers including Nvidia, Blackstone, Royal Bank of Canada (RBC), Palo Alto Networks, Adobe, and T-Mobile run Factory to ship code, review PRs, run tests, and deploy continuously - getting smarter with every cycle.

In 2026, we raised $200M at a $5B valuation, bringing our total funding to over $400M. We are backed by world-class investors and operators including Khosla Ventures, Sequoia, Blackstone, Ali Ghodsi (CEO of Databricks), and Frank Slootman (Former CEO of Snowflake).




ABOUT THE ROLE 



Factory is bringing autonomy to software engineering. We are actively looking for a Business Operations hire to drive the highest-priority initiatives that support Factory’s next phase of growth. This role sits at the intersection of strategy, finance, operations, marketing, growth, BD and go-to-market. You’ll report directly to bizops leadership and lead cross-functional projects that define how Factory scales. From building financial models to designing scalable processes and playbooks, you’ll be central to shaping our trajectory.




WHAT YOU WILL DO AND ACHIEVE

 - Design and implement scalable processes across GTM, customer success, finance and core operations.

 - Create compelling materials for strategic presentations and external partnerships.

 - Build and own financial models and business metrics to inform strategic decisions.

 - Develop customer success playbooks that drive adoption, activation, and measurable value.

 - Lead cross-functional projects across customer success, partnerships, community-building, and more.

 - Build dashboards and reporting systems to drive data-informed decisions across the business.

 - Partner closely with leadership and technical teams to ensure operational excellence as we scale.




QUALIFICATIONS

 - 3-4 years of experience at a top consulting firm, investment bank, private equity fund, or high-growth startup.

 - Exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities, with strong data analysis and/or financial modeling skills.

 - Proven track record of thriving in ambiguous environments and driving results under pressure.

 - Outstanding written and verbal communication.

 - Ability to break down complex problems and execute structured solutions.

 - Experience with or excitement for using the latest AI tooling (including Factory!) to increase efficiency across all functions.

 - Experience collaborating closely with technical teams and products.

Nice to have

 - Experience in AI/ML or enterprise software companies.

 - Background in B2B SaaS operations.

 - Technical background or basic coding abilities.

 - Proven record of scaling operations at early-stage startups.

ABOUT THE ROLE 



Factory is looking for a Strategic Finance hire to be a foundational member of our Finance team. You will partner directly with Sales, Operations, Engineering, Finance, and senior leadership to build the financial infrastructure that powers our most important decisions.

This is a generalist role with broad scope - spanning planning, operations, go-to-market finance, board and investor reporting, and strategic projects.




WHAT YOU WILL DO AND ACHIEVE

 - Own and maintain the company's core financial models

 - Drive the annual planning, budgeting, and forecasting cycles, partnering with leaders across the business

ABOUT THE ROLE 



As Marketing Operations Lead, you will be a founding member of our GTM Strategy & Operations team where you will own the buildout of the marketing operations function from the ground up.

You will own the systems, workflows, data, and operating infrastructure that enable marketing to scale. You will be the primary operations partner to field marketing, growth marketing, product marketing, and product-led growth. You will also own the evolution of marketing-related workflows in Factory’s own product.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role for a technical builder with the potential to evolve into a people manager role as our GTM scales. This role reports to the Head of GTM Strategy & Operations. This is an in-office role based in our San Francisco headquarters.




WHAT YOU WILL DO AND ACHIEVE

 - Build and administer the marketing automation platform and other marketing technology stack.

 - Build scalable processes for campaign ops, lead management, lifecycle programs, attribution, etc.

 - Create clear documentation, governance, and measurement standards for the marketing ecosystem.

 - Own all the definitions and technical implementation of marketing-related data structures and metrics.

 - Build the operational foundation for product-led growth, including user journeys, lifecycle workflows, product signals, and marketing activation.

 - Translate business requirements into reliable automations, integrations, data flows, and processes that help marketing achieve its goals across brand awareness, pipeline generation, and growth.

 - Find novel ways to use Factory droids to streamline and scale marketing workflows.

 - Partner with the broader centralized GTM Strategy & Operations team while maintaining clear ownership of Marketing and PLG Operations.

 - Design for scale while keeping the team lean, automated, and high leverage.




QUALIFICATIONS

 - Strong understanding of demand generation, lifecycle marketing, campaign operations, and marketing funnel measurement.

 - Experience administering and operationalizing Salesforce CRM.

 - Experience building marketing operations in an enterprise SaaS environment.

 - A technical mindset and the ability to learn and use new technologies quickly.

 - Experience designing systems and processes for a rapidly growing company.

 - Familiarity with GDPR, CCPA/CPRA and how it impacts marketing.

 - Comfort working cross-functionally with Marketing, Sales, Product, Data, Engineering, and Operations.

 - An operator’s mindset: you build, troubleshoot, document, and improve.

 - Strong AI fluency and a practical instinct for using AI to increase leverage.

jobs.title: GTM Strategy & Operations, AMER Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT FACTORY



Our mission is to create a world where software builds and improves itself.

We build the platform for self-improving software development, helping the world's largest enterprise engineering teams turn their organizations into autonomous software factories. Customers including Nvidia, Blackstone, Royal Bank of Canada (RBC), Palo Alto Networks, Adobe, and T-Mobile run Factory to ship code, review PRs, run tests, and deploy continuously - getting smarter with every cycle.

In 2026, we raised $200M at a $5B valuation, bringing our total funding to over $400M. We are backed by world-class investors and operators including Khosla Ventures, Sequoia, Blackstone, Ali Ghodsi (CEO of Databricks), and Frank Slootman (Former CEO of Snowflake).




ABOUT THE ROLE 



As a GTM Strategy & Operations Lead, you will be a founding member of our GTM Strategy & Operations team, embedded as the strategic partner to the sales leaders running our AMER sales organization.

You will own segment performance alongside those leaders: the strategy behind the number, the operating cadence and tactics that drive it, and the analysis that explains what is working and what is not. From forecasting and pipeline management to territory design, capacity planning, quota and incentive structures, and go-to-market strategy, you will touch nearly every lever that makes a sales organization perform.

This is a high-visibility seat at the center of the business. The role is a direct path to a deep understanding of commercial strategy and operational excellence in a high-growth environment.




WHAT YOU WILL DO AND ACHIEVE

 - Partner directly with Enterprise, Mid-Market and BDR leadership to define segment strategy, growth priorities, and execution plans.

 - Translate company-level goals into segment targets, operating plans, and measurable KPIs.

 - Own the forecast for your segments: run the cadence, pressure-test the calls, and give leadership a defensible view of where the quarter lands.

 - Lead high-impact analyses that inform critical decisions across pipeline health, conversion, capacity planning, segmentation, incentive design, and headcount investment.

 - Build the financial and operating models used to evaluate trade-offs and quantify the impact of GTM decisions.

 - Own territory and account coverage design, quota setting, and the mechanics that make both defensible to reps and leadership.

 - Design and run the core business cadences that create accountability: weekly pipeline reviews, forecast calls, and QBRs.

 - Build the dashboards and reporting infrastructure that give leadership visibility into performance, productivity, and pipeline generation.

 - Establish the metrics that distinguish top performers, diagnose the root causes of underperformance, and scale what works across the team.

 - Improve Salesforce and the surrounding GTM stack so data integrity, workflow efficiency, and reporting keep pace with the business.

 - Project-manage cross-functional initiatives spanning Sales, Marketing, Partnerships, Engineering & Product, Finance, Recruiting, and Operations.

 - Find novel ways to use Factory droids to automate the reporting, analysis, and deal support work that would otherwise consume the team.

 - Roll up your sleeves on immediate problems while building the long-term infrastructure, and present clear, structured recommendations to senior leadership.




QUALIFICATIONS



 - 4+ years of professional experience, ideally in consulting, investment banking, private equity, corporate strategy, or a high-growth startup.

 - Strong analytical skills: You go deep on data and structure analyses quickly to answer the business question at hand. You know the data underneath your work, including where it comes from, how it's built, and where it falls short. You can defend your numbers and have a point of view.

 - Ownership: You take initiative, drive problems to the finish, bring in the right people at the right time, and hold yourself accountable for the outcome.

 - Bias for action: You deliver high-quality work on tight timelines and in high-stakes moments.

 - Judgment and a nose for value: You can tell which problems will move the business most, focus there, and deprioritize the rest. You know when 80% is good enough and when it isn't.

 - Comfort with ambiguity and change: You turn messy, undefined problems into a clear plan. We move fast, and direction can change. You see that as part of the job, not a disruption, and you adjust without losing momentum.

 - Process and operational thinking: You solve a problem once, then document and systematize it so it stays solved. You know where to standardize and where to keep flexibility for a specific deal, rep, or segment.

 - Communication and stakeholder management: You're credible with sales leaders, engineers, and executives, and you earn senior stakeholders' confidence with clear, well-structured recommendations. Strong written and verbal communication is a must.

 - AI fluency: You have a practical instinct for using AI to increase your leverage. You also know its limits and hold its output to the same standard as your own work.

 - Advanced Excel or Sheets is a must. Experience with Salesforce, SQL, and BI tools is a plus.

 - Experience in Sales, Sales Strategy, Business Operations, or Revenue Operations is a plus.



Location: This is an in-office role based in our San Francisco headquarters.

jobs.description:
ABOUT FACTORY



Our mission is to create a world where software builds and improves itself.

We build the platform for self-improving software development, helping the world's largest enterprise engineering teams turn their organizations into autonomous software factories. Customers including Nvidia, Blackstone, Royal Bank of Canada (RBC), Palo Alto Networks, Adobe, and T-Mobile run Factory to ship code, review PRs, run tests, and deploy continuously - getting smarter with every cycle.

In 2026, we raised $200M at a $5B valuation, bringing our total funding to over $400M. We are backed by world-class investors and operators including Khosla Ventures, Sequoia, Blackstone, Ali Ghodsi (CEO of Databricks), and Frank Slootman (Former CEO of Snowflake).




ABOUT THE ROLE 



The Strategic Partnerships Lead will define and grow Factory’s most critical relationships across technology, enterprise and hyperscaler partnerships. In this role, you will create one-of-a-kind strategic partnerships across the industry, define a comprehensive partnerships strategy that drives material impact for the business and serve as the deal lead negotiating partnerships end-to-end. This is a high impact role and you will be a founding member of our exceptional business development team. 

The ideal candidate is a high-agency partnerships leader with AI-native expertise and proven track record designing, negotiating and delivering high-impact deals and partnerships for fast-growing technology companies. You can deftly flex between engaging C-suite executives at large enterprises and leading cross-functional efforts with engineering, marketing, product and design internally. You bring sharp analytical skills, data-driven decision-making and killer instincts to the role, while maintaining exceptional relationships and credibility with industry stakeholders. 

 




WHAT YOU WILL DO AND ACHIEVE

 - Define, build and lead a portfolio of strategic partnerships aligned with Factory's objectives and long-term vision, including key relationships with AI frontier labs, technology platforms and hyperscalers.

 - Own the strategic partnership roadmap with clear milestones, timelines, and ownership for performance (e.g., GTM, product innovation, revenue growth).

 - Prove out first-of-a-kind partnerships, then build the team to scale.

 - Continuously analyze the market landscape to identify opportunities for new partnerships, expanding existing partnerships and driving new initiatives.

 - Execute partnership deals from partnership design to commercial terms and deal negotiation to renewal and expansion

 - Serve as the face of Factory with key stakeholders, evangelizing and educating the market on the Factory platform

Key Elements of the Role

Deal Strategy & Negotiation

 - Define and negotiate the commercial, product, marketing and operational business terms to deliver first-of-a-kind partnerships and build scalable partner programs

 - Take ownership of the expansion and renewal strategy for key partnerships

 - Drive stakeholder alignment internally and externally to complete complex transactions

Cross-Functional Leadership

 - Develop a deep understanding of Factory's products, ecosystem, and strategic priorities.

 - Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Revenue, Research and Deployment teams to design and deliver on priority partnerships.

 - Work with Legal and Finance to oversee contracts, compliance, and renewals.

 - Partner with Marketing and Communications teams to drive joint go-to-market initiatives, co-marketing campaigns, and product launches.

Operational Excellence

 - Track, analyze, and report on partnership performance metrics, providing actionable insights to leadership.

 - Maintain accurate documentation of agreements, performance data, and key communications.

 - Drive internal team updates (e.g., weekly updates, executive briefs)

 - Identify and proactively resolve operational challenges that could impact partner success.

 - Ensure all partnerships align with company strategy and deliver measurable value.




QUALIFICATIONS

 - 6-8+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, business development, or strategic alliances within the technology sector — ideally at companies where partnerships were critical during hyper growth.

 - Demonstrated success in managing and growing complex, high-impact partnerships across AI, cloud, or enterprise platform ecosystems.

 - Experience in high-growth startup or fast-paced technology environments.

 - Strong cross-functional operating skills with experience working alongside product, engineering, legal, finance, and  GTM teams to execute complex initiatives.

 - Exceptional analytical skills with the ability to leverage data to drive strategic decisions.

 - Outstanding communication, negotiation, and executive relationship-building skills with the ability to engage at the C-suite level.

 - Strong bias for action and the ability to operate both independently and as part of cross-functional teams.

 - Self-directed and adaptable, comfortable operating in fast-moving environments with evolving priorities.

 - Consulting, investment banking, MBA, product-to-partnerships transitions, chief of staff, or government affairs backgrounds are a plus. Experience at companies like OpenAI, Anthropic, Ramp, or similar hypergrowth organizations is a plus.

jobs.title: Field Partner Sales Leader - North America East
jobs.description:
ABOUT FACTORY



Our mission is to create a world where software builds and improves itself.

We build the platform for self-improving software development, helping the world's largest enterprise engineering teams turn their organizations into autonomous software factories. Customers including Nvidia, Blackstone, Royal Bank of Canada (RBC), Palo Alto Networks, Adobe, and T-Mobile run Factory to ship code, review PRs, run tests, and deploy continuously - getting smarter with every cycle.

In 2026, we raised $200M at a $5B valuation, bringing our total funding to over $400M. We are backed by world-class investors and operators including Khosla Ventures, Sequoia, Blackstone, Ali Ghodsi (CEO of Databricks), and Frank Slootman (Former CEO of Snowflake).




ABOUT THE ROLE 



Factory is hiring a field partner sales leader to drive revenue with the field sales leaders and account executives of the cloud service providers (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), the frontier AI labs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google), and our ISV and SI partners. This role supports field sales and is primarily focused on North America / East territory. The leader will align with sales leaders and account executives, work to build the partner relationships at the account level that produce joint pipeline, and turn early-stage partnerships into repeatable co-sell.

The Near-Term Opportunity

Our near-term focus will be with the CSPs. We can show their field teams and their customers how Factory accelerates the migration of workloads to cloud infrastructure, which advances the customer's modernization goals and the cloud's committed consumption at the same time. That shared outcome is the wedge that gets us in front of cloud sellers and their accounts, and it extends naturally to the ISVs and SIs who deliver those migrations and the AI labs whose tokens are consumed.

How This Motion Builds

These are early-stage motions and partnerships. The sequence matters:

 - Make the connections. Get to the right field sales leaders and account executives inside the clouds, AI labs, ISVs, and SIs; earn a seat in their accounts.

 - Win lighthouses. Land a small number of joint, referenceable customer wins that prove the co-sell works in the field.

 - Quantify the benefit. Instrument and document the customer outcome and the partner value (migration acceleration, consumption driven, deal size) so the story is credible and repeatable.

 - Earn seller trust. Show individual AEs and their leaders that Factory makes their number easier, so co-sell becomes something they ask for.

 - Then scale. Once the motion is proven, expand it through field marketing, enablement, and formal partner programs.




WHAT YOU WILL DO AND ACHIEVE

 - Own field partner revenue. Drive partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and bookings across clouds, AI labs, ISVs, and SIs in the territory.

 - Build seller-level relationships. Develop trusted relationships with partner field sales leaders and account executives, not just alliance managers, and get into joint account planning.

 - Land the CSP migration wedge. Work with cloud field teams to identify accounts where Factory accelerates workload migration, and co-sell those opportunities to close.

 - Run the co-sell in the field. Territory and account planning, joint calls, solution narratives, deal registration, and triangulated deals (Factory + cloud + lab + SI + ISV on the same account).

 - Quantify and package the win. Turn each lighthouse into a quantified proof point and a reusable co-sell play the partner's sellers can run.

 - Enable both sides. Enable Factory's sellers to co-sell by default, and equip partner sellers to position Factory to their customers.

 - Set up the scale path. Feed proven plays into field marketing, enablement, and partner programs; build the cadence, dashboards, and joint business reviews that sustain the motion.

 - Build the team. Hire field partner sellers as partner-sourced revenue justifies headcount.




QUALIFICATIONS



 - 8+ years in enterprise tech sales and alliances; 4+ carrying or driving partner-sourced revenue with CSPs, ISVs, or SIs, with senior field experience.

 - A track record co-selling in the field with cloud and partner account executives, not just managing alliance programs from a distance.

 - Deep credibility on cloud migration and modernization: you understand how workloads move to the cloud and how that maps to committed consumption and customer outcomes.

 - Comfortable in early-stage motions where the program doesn't exist yet: you can open doors, win lighthouses, and prove value before there's infrastructure to lean on.

 - Fluent enough in the AI ecosystem (AI lab models and platforms, agent ecosystems, token economics) to sell the joint value to technical and economic buyers.

 - A builder who runs the motion personally before earning headcount, and who can align Factory Sales, Product, Marketing, and partner field teams behind a shared account.

Preferred: time inside a hyperscaler, AI lab, ISV, or SI field or partner sales organization; direct involvement in cloud migration co-sell; existing relationships with cloud and partner field leaders in North America.





Location: North America / East

ABOUT THE ROLE 



As Factory scales through hyper-growth off the back of our Series C, we are seeking a Founding HRBP to serve as a trusted partner to leaders across the org. This is a foundational role: you’ll provide hands-on partnership while helping build the HRBP function itself - the frameworks, playbooks, and practices that become its backbone as the company scales.




WHAT YOU WILL DO AND ACHIEVE



Strategic Partnership & Org Effectiveness
• Advise functional leaders on org design, workforce planning, and growth plans as the company scales.
• Own headcount planning and data integrity for your client groups
• Partner with leadership to build the playbooks and frameworks for org design, performance calibration, comp cycles, career ladders, headcount - that become the foundation for the HRBP function as it grows

Employee Relations & Coaching
• Serve as a trusted advisor on employee relations, exercising judgment on what’s a coaching moment, a policy issue, or an escalation
• Coach leaders and managers on performance, feedback, and people leadership, building trust and transparency

• Contribute to L&D, People Program, and Total Rewards initiatives.

Performance, Comp & Data
• Run performance reviews and the comp cycle for your client groups end to end - calibration, consistency, communication
• Bring a data- and metrics-driven approach - attrition, span of control, performance distribution to flag org risk before it becomes a retention problem

AI & Ways of Working
• Use AI tools, including Factory’s own product, as a core part of how you operate - dogfooding what we build
• Operate at both altitudes: build durable systems while running the day-to-day operational load, often in the same week




QUALIFICATIONS 


• 8+ years in HR, with a strong track record as an HRBP or People Partner in high-growth, fast-paced tech companies
• Strong business acumen - you understand how the company makes money and decisions well enough to be a credible partner to functional leaders
• Curious and a real problem solver - you work root causes instead of pattern-matching to the nearest existing policy
• Genuinely employee-focused - you build for the people using the systems you design
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills; able to build trust at all levels of the company
• Comfortable operating in both strategic and hands-on capacities in a dynamic, fast-changing environment
• Experience partnering with Finance on headcount planning and compensation strategy



This is an in-office position (5 days/week) in San Francisco (walking distance to Caltrain)

We can show their field teams and their customers how Factory accelerates the migration of workloads to cloud infrastructure, which advances the customer's modernization goals and the cloud's committed consumption at the same time. That shared outcome is the wedge that gets us in front of cloud sellers and their accounts, and it extends naturally to the ISVs and SIs who deliver those migrations and the AI labs whose tokens are consumed.

How This Motion Builds

These are early-stage motions and partnerships. The sequence matters:

 - Make the connections. Get to the right field sales leaders and account executives inside the clouds, AI labs, ISVs, and SIs; earn a seat in their accounts.

 - Win lighthouses. Land a small number of joint, referenceable customer wins that prove the co-sell works in the field.

 - Quantify the benefit. Instrument and document the customer outcome and the partner value (migration acceleration, consumption driven, deal size) so the story is credible and repeatable.

 - Earn seller trust. Show individual AEs and their leaders that Factory makes their number easier, so co-sell becomes something they ask for.

 - Then scale. Once the motion is proven, expand it through field marketing, enablement, and formal partner programs.

 


WHAT YOU WILL DO AND ACHIEVE

 - Own field partner revenue. Drive partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and bookings across clouds, AI labs, ISVs, and SIs in the territory.

 - Build seller-level relationships. Develop trusted relationships with partner field sales leaders and account executives, not just alliance managers, and get into joint account planning.

 - Land the CSP migration wedge. Work with cloud field teams to identify accounts where Factory accelerates workload migration, and co-sell those opportunities to close.

 - Run the co-sell in the field. Territory and account planning, joint calls, solution narratives, deal registration, and triangulated deals (Factory + cloud + lab + SI + ISV on the same account).

 - Quantify and package the win. Turn each lighthouse into a quantified proof point and a reusable co-sell play the partner's sellers can run.

 - Enable both sides. Enable Factory's sellers to co-sell by default, and equip partner sellers to position Factory to their customers.

 - Set up the scale path. Feed proven plays into field marketing, enablement, and partner programs; build the cadence, dashboards, and joint business reviews that sustain the motion.

 - Build the team. Hire field partner sellers as partner-sourced revenue justifies headcount.

 


QUALIFICATIONS

 

 - 8+ years in enterprise tech sales and alliances; 4+ carrying or driving partner-sourced revenue with CSPs, ISVs, or SIs, with senior field experience.

 - A track record co-selling in the field with cloud and partner account executives, not just managing alliance programs from a distance.

 - Deep credibility on cloud migration and modernization: you understand how workloads move to the cloud and how that maps to committed consumption and customer outcomes.

 - Comfortable in early-stage motions where the program doesn't exist yet: you can open doors, win lighthouses, and prove value before there's infrastructure to lean on.

 - Fluent enough in the AI ecosystem (AI lab models and platforms, agent ecosystems, token economics) to sell the joint value to technical and economic buyers.

 - A builder who runs the motion personally before earning headcount, and who can align Factory Sales, Product, Marketing, and partner field teams behind a shared account.

Preferred: time inside a hyperscaler, AI lab, ISV, or SI field or partner sales organization; direct involvement in cloud migration co-sell; existing relationships with cloud and partner field leaders in North America.
